basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) is inviting applications for one Consultant (Electrical Engineer) post, to be filled on a contractual basis for 11 months at Noida. The consolidated pay is Rs.40,000 to Rs.50,000 per month. The essential qualification is BE/B.Tech (Electrical Engineering) or equivalent, and the maximum age is 40 years as on 01.11.2026. Applications are online only; the link is active from 19 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply only through the electronic application form (Online) on the link given at the end of the notice. The link is active from 19 November 2026 to 30 November 2026, and 30 November 2026 is the last date.
The address printed for the online form is https://stimulate.icsi.edu/RECRUITMENT/IndexHome/IndexHome. It can also be copied and pasted into the address bar of the browser.
Use Windows Explorer (6.x to 11.x only) or Google Chrome with JavaScript enabled. The notice says not to use Mozilla Firefox, Netscape Navigator or any other browser.
Fill the online resume form completely and carefully. Incomplete or vague applications, or applications not in the prescribed format, will be rejected summarily.

Do not enter special characters such as quotation marks, slashes or &. Enter minimum words or characters in the university name, specialization, major responsibilities, address and board or school name fields.
Upload a resume file that does not exceed 100 KB.
Enter percentages rounded down to the lower whole number (49.3% or 49.8% is entered as 49%). Convert grades to numerical equivalent percentages.
Do not send the hard copy of the online application form, CV or certificates to the Institute.
Applicants need a valid personal e-mail address, because ICSI reserves the right to communicate through e-mail and not by post. Queries can be sent to [email protected].

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About ICSI
content_sections.text: ICSI describes itself as a statutory body set up under an act of Parliament, the Company Secretaries Act, 1980, to regulate and develop the profession of Company Secretaries in India. The notice is issued from ICSI House, 22, Institutional Area, Lodi Road, New Delhi –110003. Queries go to the Directorate of HR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Training experience forming a part of the curriculum is not counted towards the total experience. The cut-off date for all purposes, including age, qualifications and experience, is 01.11.2026. All educational qualifications must be from recognized universities or institutions in India or abroad. Courses offered by autonomous institutions should be equivalent to courses approved or recognized by AIU/UGC/AICTE. Proficiency in Computer Applications is essential for the post. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility criteria before applying.

rows.requirement: BE/B.Tech (Electrical Engineering) or equivalent from Government recognized Universities / Institutes
Preference shall be given to candidates having post qualification experience of more than 03 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated, and the payout will be in the range of Rs.40,000/- to Rs.50,000/- per month. The tenure is 11 months. The notice says the period of contract may be extended every year up to a maximum period of two more years, based on performance and requirement. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the selection process and joining the assignment or on its completion.

content_sections.heading: ICSI Consultant (Electrical Engineer) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice calls the duties indicative: Providing technical assistance for acquisition or purchase of land or premises from Govt authorities or private parties by following due process procedures. Planning, execution, monitoring and supervision of all infrastructure projects, including new construction, additional construction to existing buildings, furnishing, repairing, renovation, refurbishing, maintenance works, etc. Assessment and verification of building drawings, concept plans, cost estimates, structural audit reports, MEP plans, HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire safety drawings, etc., as per prevalent Govt norms, rules and regulations. Scrutiny and processing of bills for release of payment to various contractors, PMC agencies, architects, consultants, etc. Monitoring day-to-day construction activities on site for ongoing building projects. Ensuring proper quality control checks as per design specifications and standards for ongoing construction projects. Maintaining proper records, including correspondence, reports etc., and technical documentation. Ensuring the safe, efficient operation of building systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lift and fire safety) through preventive building maintenance, repairs, vendor management etc., for all premises of the Institute. Conducting inspections and ensuring compliance with safety standards for all premises of the Institute. Coordination and meetings with the architects, contractors, consultants, PMC agencies, structural auditors, prospective bidders and tenderers involved in various projects. Periodic site visits and site review meetings at various project sites. Presentation and report preparation for various projects. Preparation of notice and notes on agenda for meetings of various Infrastructure Committees, the Executive Committee and the Council on various matters. Preparation of minutes and Action Taken Reports (ATR) of those meetings. Representing or attending meetings related to infrastructure matters of the Institute or on behalf of the Institute. Any other matter assigned by the Competent Authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICSI Consultant (Electrical Engineer)
content_sections.text: Apply only through the electronic application form (Online) on the link given at the end of the notice. The link is active from 19 November 2026 to 30 November 2026, and 30 November 2026 is the last date. The address printed for the online form is https://stimulate.icsi.edu/RECRUITMENT/IndexHome/IndexHome . It can also be copied and pasted into the address bar of the browser. Use Windows Explorer (6.x to 11.x only) or Google Chrome with JavaScript enabled. The notice says not to use Mozilla Firefox, Netscape Navigator or any other browser. Fill the online resume form completely and carefully. Incomplete or vague applications, or applications not in the prescribed format, will be rejected summarily. Do not enter special characters such as quotation marks, slashes or &. Enter minimum words or characters in the university name, specialization, major responsibilities, address and board or school name fields. Upload a resume file that does not exceed 100 KB. Enter percentages rounded down to the lower whole number (49.3% or 49.8% is entered as 49%). Convert grades to numerical equivalent percentages. Do not send the hard copy of the online application form, CV or certificates to the Institute. Applicants need a valid personal e-mail address, because ICSI reserves the right to communicate through e-mail and not by post. Queries can be sent to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to shortlisting and an interview. Submission of an application or fulfilment of the eligibility conditions does not confer any right to be shortlisted or called for interview. ICSI reserves the right to call for interview only those candidates who in its opinion are most suitable for the post. ICSI also reserves the right to fix a minimum eligibility standard or benchmark, to restrict the number of candidates called for interview, and to raise the eligibility criteria for that purpose. Candidates should check their e-mail regularly for information about the interview. Original documents are required for verification at the time of the interview. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.
